arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT json_object('pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending'),'events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'cache',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache),'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'capacity',capacity)) FROM flights),'fare_holds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds)) AS state

SELECT json_object('pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'charge',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending'),'cancel_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds),'missing_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND c.booking_id IS NULL),'oversold',(SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),'multiple_captured',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT booking_id FROM charges WHERE state='captured' GROUP BY booking_id HAVING count(*)>1)),'ineligible_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status!='confirmed' OR b.booking_id IS NULL),'cancelled_but_confirmed',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed'),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config)) AS audit

SELECT json_object('failed_requests',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 35)),'bad_confirmed',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id)!=1)),'cancelled',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled'),'events_unmatched',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking',o.booking_id,'status',o.status,'payload',o.payload)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status!='delivered' OR b.booking_id IS NULL),'duplicate_refs',(SELECT json_group_array(client_reference) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1))) AS audit

SELECT b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.confirmed_at,f.price_cents AS current_price,h.price_cents AS held_price,h.until_step,(SELECT value FROM cache WHERE key='quote:'||b.flight_id) AS cached_quote FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.flight_id=b.flight_id LEFT JOIN fare_holds h ON h.flight_id=b.flight_id WHERE b.confirmed_at>=20 ORDER BY b.confirmed_at DESC LIMIT 12
